$comment: Ontology for German medical documents. Classes form an is-a hierarchy (multiple parents allowed); rules attached to a class apply to all its descendants. Loaded into a networkx graph by app/knowledge/graph.py.

settings.suspicious_reason: This document shows signs of manipulation. Do not change any medicine because of it. Ask your doctor or pharmacist to confirm it.

legal_bases.label: § 630e BGB
legal_bases.text: Patients must be informed about their treatment in a way they can understand.

legal_bases.label: § 630g BGB
legal_bases.text: Patients have the right to see their medical records and get copies.

legal_bases.label: § 31a SGB V
legal_bases.text: People who take at least three prescribed medicines long-term have a right to a medication plan.

legal_bases.label: § 39 (1a) SGB V
legal_bases.text: Hospitals must organise the care you need after discharge (discharge management).

legal_bases.label: Art. 9 DSGVO / GDPR
legal_bases.text: Health data is a special category of personal data and may only be processed with explicit consent or another specific legal basis.

legal_bases.label: Art. 5 DSGVO / GDPR
legal_bases.text: Personal data must be limited to what is necessary and kept no longer than needed.

resources.label: Emergency number 112
resources.description: For life-threatening symptoms such as chest pain, breathing problems or signs of a stroke, call 112.

resources.label: 116117 – medical on-call service
resources.description: For urgent problems outside practice opening hours that are not life-threatening.

resources.label: Your family doctor (Hausarzt)
resources.description: Ask about anything that is unclear. Bring this explanation and your medication plan.

resources.label: Your pharmacy
resources.description: Pharmacists explain your medicines and check them for interactions, free of charge.

resources.label: Was hab' ich? – findings in plain language
resources.description: Free service: medical students and doctors translate medical findings into easy language.

resources.label: gesund.bund.de
resources.description: Official health information of the German Federal Ministry of Health, in plain language.

resources.label: Independent Patient Advice (UPD)
resources.description: Free, independent advice on health and patient rights.
